facts.text: Deborah attended a yoga retreat near her mom's place last week.

evidence.quote: last week I got to go to this yoga retreat near my mom's place.

facts.text: Deborah described the yoga retreat as life-changing and emphasized the importance of nature and self-reflection.

evidence.quote: It was so cool - I got to hang with nature and really get to know myself. Definitely life-changing! That's how beautiful it was there!
Nature and self-reflection have helped me see how beautiful every moment is.
